gloss: high waves; large waves; rough seas

definitions.gloss: high waves; large waves; rough seas
definitions.explanation: Abnormally large ocean waves, typically caused by storms, typhoons, or strong winds. A common hazard mentioned in weather warnings.

examples.japanese: {高波|たかなみ}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please watch out for high waves.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{高波|たかなみ}が{予想|よそう}される。
examples.english: High waves are expected due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {高波|たかなみ}で{海岸|かいがん}の{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}が{通行止|つうこうど}めになった。
examples.english: The coastal promenade was closed due to high waves.

notes:
Frequently appears in weather forecasts and disaster warnings, especially during typhoon season. Not to be confused with {津波|つなみ} (tsunami), which is caused by earthquakes or underwater landslides rather than weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高波|たかなみ}{注意報|ちゅういほう}: high wave advisory
- {高波|たかなみ}{警報|けいほう}: high wave warning
- {高波|たかなみ}にさらわれる: to be swept away by high waves
- {高波|たかなみ}が{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる: high waves surge in

RELATED WORDS:
- {津波|つなみ}: tsunami — seismically caused, different phenomenon
- {波浪|はろう}: waves (formal/weather term)
- {荒波|あらなみ}: rough waves — literary/poetic
